title: Research candidate
description: One proposed data source candidate from the research-sources skill. Written to research/candidates/<slug>.json.

slug.description: kebab-case id, matches the filename and the memo filename suffix

gap.description: what gap in the screener this would fill

granularity.description: e.g. tract, ZCTA, county, metro, national

history_available.description: how far back data goes, if relevant to backtesting

license.description: license/ToS summary: login wall? commercial-use restriction? attribution required?

cost.description: should state 'free' plus any rate limit, or 'none found - flag as risk'

access_method.description: API, bulk CSV/XLSX download, Socrata, etc. — note any auth/key requirement

correlation.description: quantitative evaluation vs FHFA HPI / Zillow ZORI, if app/research/evaluate_series.py was run; null if not computed
